projects.title: OCR
projects.description: Developed a Django and DRF-based API system designed to handle image-based text extraction and social media like-detection. The system accepts AWS S3 image URLs and performs automated feature extraction and classification using OpenCV, PyTesseract, and Keras.
solutions: Exposed REST API endpoints that accept AWS S3 image URLs along with designated processing tasks.
Implemented a like-detection workflow using OpenCV and NumPy to convert images from BGR to HSV color space, isolate red-colored regions, detect contours, and crop target regions to 224x224 pixels.
Normalized pixel values to a range of [-1, 1] as float32 arrays before passing preprocessed image vectors into a trained Keras model.
Evaluated Keras model predictions against a 79% confidence threshold to determine the presence of a like/heart icon.
Developed an image-to-text OCR processing pipeline using OpenCV and NumPy to convert raw uploaded image bytes into image matrices using cv.imdecode().
Integrated PyTesseract and Tesseract OCR configured with multi-language support (English, Hebrew, Arabic, German, Spanish), OCR engine mode (--oem 1), and page segmentation mode (--psm 6).
Implemented post-processing string manipulation routines to sanitize OCR outputs, stripping extra whitespace and formatting extracted text results.

projects.title: Wizepal-Python
projects.description: Built a Django/DRF-based document-processing API designed to accept and extract structured text from PDF, DOC, and DOCX files. Implemented hybrid extraction methods utilizing direct text parsing and OCR fallbacks for scanned documents, alongside token-based document splitting and cloud storage management.
solutions: Developed a Django/DRF backend service for ingestion, extraction, and validation of multi-format documents.
Implemented PDF text extraction using PyMuPDF, with automated fallback to Tesseract OCR and OpenCV/NumPy rendering when text content was missing or scanned.
Integrated python-docx for native text extraction from DOCX files.
Configured headless LibreOffice integration to perform programmatic conversion of legacy DOC files into PDF and plain text formats.
Built a document splitting module utilizing tiktoken to calculate token counts and chunk large documents into smaller files according to configurable token boundaries.
Configured cloud storage operations using boto3 with DigitalOcean Spaces' S3-compatible API for downloading source files, storing generated chunk files, and obtaining temporary URLs.
Implemented automated cleanup logic for temporary local files following processing execution.
Set up scheduled processing tasks using django-crontab, integrated Sentry for real-time error tracking, and configured SendGrid for operational notifications.

projects.title: Court Case Document Scraping & Processing
projects.description: Built a Python-based web scraping and document automation system designed to extract court decision records and download associated PDF documents. Handled complex ASP.NET state persistence, data deduplication, cloud storage synchronization, PDF compression, and automated reporting.
solutions: Implemented HTTP session persistence using Python Requests to navigate ASP.NET state management, maintaining target fields including __VIEWSTATE, __VIEWSTATEGENERATOR, and __EVENTVALIDATION.
Parsed HTML responses using BeautifulSoup to locate decision records, parse form inputs, and capture identifiers necessary for PDF generation.
Automated PDF retrieval and local file storage using dynamic session cookies.
Integrated Ghostscript via subprocess calls to perform lossy/lossless compression on downloaded PDF files before remote upload.
Configured object storage pipelines using boto3 to upload documents with UUID-based naming schemes to DigitalOcean Spaces.
Implemented dual-layer data tracking utilizing SQLite for local duplicate checking and process state management alongside MySQL for permanent record indexing.
Implemented pre-retrieval deduplication checks to ensure redundant HTTP calls and duplicate storage charges were prevented.
Configured SendGrid automated email notifications and comprehensive system logging for error monitoring.

projects.title: PDF Data Extraction & Processing System
projects.description: Developed a Python-based PDF processing platform capable of extracting structured datasets from complex unstructured PDFs and exposing functionality via Django REST Framework endpoints. Supported coordinate-based field extraction, table parsing, Base64 document decoding, and regex pattern matching.
solutions: Implemented coordinate-based data extraction rules using PDFQuery across multi-page document structures.
Developed table extraction pipelines using Tabula and Pandas to merge disparate tabular information, standardizing corporate/employee data into JSON structures.
Integrated PDFPlumber and pdfminer.six to parse unstructured PDF text into structured database models.
Implemented Base64 payload decoding, temporary file system creation, stream validation, and automatic post-processing file purges.
Exposed REST API endpoints using Django REST Framework for submitting PDF table extraction jobs and resume parsing.
Constructed regular expression rules to parse targeted data points such as contact numbers, email addresses, and metadata across PDF, DOCX, and TXT extensions.
Built structured API response schemas, input parameter validation, error logging, and exception handling protocols.

projects.title: Image Analyzer & Color Analysis System
projects.description: Developed a Python desktop application for automated computer vision operations and color space analysis. Implemented image transformations across BGR, RGB, HSV, and LAB color spaces, pixel-level color detection, statistical distribution analysis, persistent profile storage, and a graphical user interface.
solutions: Developed image processing pipelines using OpenCV for frame loading, thresholding, masking, pixel extraction, and color transformations across BGR, RGB, HSV, and LAB spaces.
Implemented configurable lower and upper boundary HSV thresholding via cv2.inRange() to isolate distinct color regions.
Extracted pixel vectors and computed regional counts using vectorized NumPy array operations.
Calculated LAB color values to derive average Lightness, A, B parameters, and mathematical chroma metrics.
Developed dominant-color detection using Pandas to group LAB color ranges, evaluate frequency distributions, and determine percentage presence.
Built programmatic translation logic to map derived LAB values back to corresponding HSV color values.
Engineered image comparison algorithms based on relative saturation shifts and percentage delta variance.
Constructed an SQLite database schema for managing color profiles, dynamic image metadata, and persistent analysis results.
Designed a CustomTkinter/Tkinter desktop interface featuring custom inputs, dropdown elements, configuration forms, and dynamic data presentation.
Implemented visualization utilities using Matplotlib to render saturation channel masks and visual comparisons.

projects.title: Hot Mobile Python
projects.description: Developed a Python-based browser automation system using Selenium and Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) for automating complex web-based workflows. Implemented reusable browser abstractions, dynamic form interaction, network request interception, response extraction, session persistence, OTP handling, structured JSON processing, error handling, logging, process management, and automated cleanup.
solutions: Developed a custom Selenium Chrome WebDriver abstraction extending webdriver.Chrome with reusable browser automation utilities.
Configured Chrome performance logging to capture browser network events through Selenium.
Implemented Chrome DevTools Protocol integration using execute_cdp_cmd() for full-page screenshots and HTTP response-body retrieval.

Developed network request interception by monitoring Chrome performance logs, identifying target POST requests, tracking request IDs, waiting for corresponding responses, and retrieving response bodies.
Implemented reusable element-waiting utilities for dynamically loaded web elements with configurable timeout handling.
Developed generic input-handling utilities for clicking, clearing, typing, selecting dropdown values, and interacting with dynamically rendered elements.
Implemented JavaScript execution through Selenium for interacting with elements when standard WebDriver operations were insufficient.
Developed browser-side performance-log caching and management, including merging, storing, retrieving, and clearing captured logs.
Implemented full-page screenshot capture using Chrome DevTools Protocol with fallback to Selenium screenshot functionality.
Developed structured multi-step browser automation using reusable Python methods for navigation, form interaction, validation, and state transitions.
Implemented support for dynamic dropdown/listbox handling, including extracting available options and selecting matching elements.
Developed mechanisms to retrieve dynamically loaded data directly from intercepted HTTP API responses when required DOM elements were unavailable.
Implemented session persistence using browser sessionStorage, allowing session data to be extracted to JSON and restored in subsequent browser instances.
Developed session validation and refresh logic by loading stored browser session data and checking application state after restoration.
Implemented OTP polling and state tracking, periodically querying an HTTP endpoint and detecting newly generated OTP values.
Built structured JSON input transformation, including recursive replacement of None values and conversion of external JSON data into automation-ready structures.
Implemented separate data-processing structures for multiple input items using Python dictionaries and lists before passing data into browser automation routines.
Developed configurable automation paths for different payment interfaces using reusable Python methods and Selenium form interactions.
Implemented interaction with HTML iframes, including detecting the target iframe, switching browser context, waiting for document readiness, filling fields, and returning to the default content.
Implemented HTML <select> interaction using Selenium's Select API for selecting options by visible text, index, and value.
Developed centralized error handling and exception logging using Python try/except, traceback capture, structured error responses, and persisted debugging information.
Implemented application-level logging with timestamped daily log directories, file handlers, console output, and configurable logging levels.
Developed browser/process cleanup functionality using psutil to identify and terminate Chrome processes after automation execution.
Implemented a local health-check process using a lightweight HTTP endpoint and subprocess.Popen() for monitoring and restarting the supporting process when required.
Developed an automated execution loop with state reset, execution-time measurement, error handling, and controlled termination.
Implemented HTTP GET/POST integrations using the Requests library for exchanging JSON data with external APIs and processing HTTP response status codes.
Added persistent JSON debugging artifacts for API responses, browser logs, processed data, and webhook payloads to simplify troubleshooting.
Implemented automatic cleanup of debug-log directories older than seven days using Python file-system and timestamp operations.
Created a Windows batch execution script to activate the Python virtual environment and launch the automation application.
Structured the application into reusable components such as browser management, authentication handling, form automation, session management, utility functions, and process monitoring.

projects.title: Street Easy
projects.description: Developed a Django and Django REST Framework-based web application with automated multi-step form processing. Implemented REST APIs, request-driven workflow automation, authentication and session management, multi-form data handling, multi-image upload processing, validation, and integration of multiple application steps into a reusable backend workflow.
solutions: Developed backend functionality using Django and Django REST Framework with reusable API endpoints and application components.
Implemented REST API integration using Python requests for programmatically executing application workflows.
Automated multi-step form submission containing 5-6+ sequential forms while maintaining required state between each step.
Implemented request-based form processing for sending structured form data and handling server responses.
Developed multipart form-data handling for processing forms containing both structured fields and uploaded files.
Implemented multi-image upload functionality with support for sending multiple files within a single workflow.
Developed authentication and session-management mechanisms for maintaining authenticated requests across multiple API calls.
Implemented request headers, cookies, authentication data, and session state handling for consecutive HTTP requests.
Developed reusable Python functions for executing individual workflow steps and passing the resulting state/data to subsequent steps.
Implemented response handling and validation for each API request to detect successful and failed workflow stages.
Developed JSON parsing and transformation logic for processing API request and response payloads.
Implemented form-data validation and structured error handling for invalid or incomplete request data.
Developed file-handling utilities for preparing local images and attaching them to multipart HTTP requests.
Implemented sequential request execution to automate dependent API operations while preserving authentication and request context.
Developed reusable HTTP request utilities for GET, POST, and multipart requests using the Python Requests library.
Implemented exception handling and logging around API requests, file uploads, authentication, and multi-step processing.
Structured the automation into reusable Python components to simplify maintenance and extension of additional form-processing steps.

projects.title: Airbnb-Review
projects.description: Developed a Django-based review management and analytics platform that integrates with an external review-data provider to collect, process, store, filter, analyze, and export review information. Containerized using Docker Compose with PostgreSQL, Gunicorn, and Nginx, featuring HTTPS configuration and background job scheduling.
solutions: Designed and implemented REST APIs using Django REST Framework for review retrieval, filtering, resource management, and data export.
Implemented JWT-based authentication and role-aware access to user and review data.
Built a reusable Pydantic-based filtering layer supporting date ranges, rating ranges, resource selection, and configurable sorting.
Implemented review analytics including average ratings and rating-distribution summaries alongside paginated review results.
Integrated an external review-data API and developed a parsing pipeline to transform nested API responses into structured database records.
Implemented duplicate detection and bulk database insertion to avoid storing duplicate review records and improve ingestion efficiency.
Developed scheduled background processing for pending resources, review collection, processing-status management, and email notifications.
Built Excel export functionality using Polars for efficient transformation and generation of downloadable review reports.
Implemented bulk resource creation and deletion APIs with validation and duplicate handling.
Added Swagger/OpenAPI documentation for API endpoints and request/response structures.
Containerized the application using Docker Compose with separate application, database, and Nginx services.
Configured Gunicorn and Nginx for production application serving, reverse proxying, HTTPS termination, static-file handling, and frontend hosting.
Implemented PostgreSQL persistence with Docker volumes and database health checks.
Automated SSL certificate renewal using Certbot and scheduled jobs.
Added Nginx security rules to restrict access to sensitive files, hidden files, suspicious paths, and selected malicious request patterns.
Configured centralized container logging through GELF-compatible logging configuration.
Added application and container health checks to improve service reliability during deployment and restart.
Created Makefile-based commands to simplify Docker installation, environment setup, application startup, shutdown, cleanup, and restart operations.

projects.title: Videndum-Scrape
projects.description: Developed an automated product data extraction and catalog preparation system using Python and Selenium-based browser automation. Processed source data from Excel, performed web catalog searches, extracted technical specifications, pricing, and assets, and structured output for e-commerce ingestion.
solutions: Developed automated browser-based product scraping using Selenium and Undetected ChromeDriver for dynamically rendered product pages.
Implemented headless Chrome execution to support automated scraping without requiring a graphical environment.
Built reusable scraping workflows for searching products by SKU/part number and validating the matching product page before extraction.
Extracted product information including SKU, product name, descriptions, technical specifications, pricing, categories, weight, related SKUs, and other catalog attributes.
Implemented JavaScript execution through Selenium to extract dynamically rendered HTML content and structured technical-specification tables.
Automated product image extraction and downloading, including deterministic image naming and local file validation.
Built reusable utilities for category and weight enrichment using reference Excel files.
Implemented duplicate/file-existence checks to avoid unnecessary image downloads and repeated processing.
Designed manufacturer-specific scraper classes while sharing common utilities for CSV generation, logging, image handling, and product metadata processing.
Added error handling and per-product logging so individual scraping failures did not terminate the complete catalog-processing workflow.
Implemented automatic screenshot capture for failed product pages to assist debugging and investigation.
Added handling for unavailable products, request timeouts, missing product information, and incomplete page elements.
Implemented related-product extraction and filtering to generate related SKU mappings for the resulting catalog.
Transformed scraped data into a standardized e-commerce product-import CSV containing product metadata, pricing, inventory configuration, images, categories, and relationships.
Used Pandas for Excel reading, tabular transformation, and CSV generation.
Implemented configurable CSV delimiters and generated timestamped output files for catalog processing.
Added structured logging with timestamped log files for monitoring scraping progress and troubleshooting failures.
Added configurable price-based filtering to skip products that did not meet the required processing criteria.
Built reusable filesystem validation and directory-creation logic for input files, output files, product images, and error screenshots.
Created a modular architecture where common scraping and transformation functionality could be reused across different manufacturer-specific implementations.

projects.title: Camp-Life
projects.description: Developed an automated content-processing platform using Django that collects web content, processes data via AI workflows, creates multimedia assets using browser automation, uploads assets remotely, and syncs status updates with external data platforms in a state-driven pipeline.
solutions: Built Selenium-based browser automation to open target websites and extract rendered page content using JavaScript execution.
Designed a database-backed state machine workflow managing progress through PENDING, SCRAPED, GPT_COMPLETED, NOTEBOOKLM_ADDED, COMPLETED, ERROR, and SYNCHRONIZED states.
Integrated OpenAI API to transform scraped website content using dynamic prompts and persist outputs.
Built automated browser workflows to manage project creation, media synthesis, and content retrieval on third-party platforms.
Containerized Selenium Hub and Chrome nodes using Docker Compose with shared storage volumes to support parallel automation workers.
Implemented concurrent pipeline processing using Python ThreadPoolExecutor to handle scraping, AI transformation, and asset processing asynchronously.
Created exception handling decorators, retry trackers, and error-logging mechanisms for robust job recovery.
Implemented a localhost socket-locking mechanism to prevent duplicate cron task executions.
Built an FTP file delivery component with retry policies to store generated media on remote servers.
Integrated pyairtable to perform batch status updates and error synchronization back to external databases.
Configured scheduled Django cron tasks for automated background polling and job dispatching.
Implemented browser instance lifecycle management, automated driver cleanup, and invalid session recovery strategies.

projects.title: Lazada-Shopee
projects.description: Developed a Django-based e-commerce data extraction platform for collecting, processing, storing, and exporting large volumes of product information from online shopping and official product catalog sources. Containerized using Docker Compose with Django/Gunicorn and Nginx.
solutions: Developed HTTP-based scrapers for collecting product information from e-commerce platforms, including request and pagination logic.
Implemented automatic detection of additional product pages, generating page-specific request URLs dynamically.
Integrated configurable proxy endpoints for outbound scraping requests with dynamic proxy-port selection.
Implemented persistent HTTP sessions for official product catalog requests, extracting dynamic build metadata prior to data retrieval.
Used Pydantic models to validate and normalize extracted product data, flattening nested structures into standard models.
Designed Django models for managing shops and product records using explicit processing states (IDLE, PENDING, PROCESSING, COMPLETED, FAILED).
Implemented high-efficiency bulk database insertion using bulk_create().
Implemented Excel generation using Polars and XlsxWriter with automated column sizing, formatting, and numeric precision.
Implemented scheduled Django cron processing for shops marked for execution.
Implemented automatic cleanup of previously stored product data when a shop is scheduled for a new run.
Created Docker Compose configuration for the Django application and Nginx, utilizing Gunicorn as the application server.
Automated Django migrations and static-file collection during container startup.
Added structured logging throughout scraping, processing, database, and export operations.

projects.title: Lexor-Miami
projects.description: Designed and developed a desktop-based automated web data extraction system for collecting structured product information from search results. Constructed using a hybrid Python and JavaScript extraction architecture using Selenium and packaged as an executable via PyInstaller.
solutions: Designed modular components isolating browser setup, extraction, query queuing, data handling, and GUI management.
Engineered a hybrid extraction model leveraging Selenium for page synchronization and injected JavaScript for DOM parsing.
Built safeExtract JavaScript wrappers to safely parse dynamic element values without breaking iteration loops.
Constructed an ETL batch processing pipeline executing CSV input reads, query processing, extraction, transformation, and output generation.
Implemented bounded retry limits for network timeouts alongside driver regeneration logic upon browser crashes.
Built an incremental checkpoint saving mechanism writing processed query batches directly to output CSV files to prevent data loss.
Normalized extracted content into tabular Pandas DataFrames, adding search-rank indices.
Used multithreading to run scraping workflows on background threads, keeping the CustomTkinter desktop interface responsive.
Built progress tracking mechanisms communicating real-time status between workers and the user interface.
Developed a desktop UI using CustomTkinter with configurable settings, thread-safe console logging, and cross-platform file triggers.
Packaged the solution into a single executable using PyInstaller with automated Chromium environment setup.

projects.title: Robot Automation – Desktop Web Automation Platform
projects.description: Developed a Windows-based desktop automation application that processes user-provided Excel combinations and performs authenticated, multi-step web workflows through HTTP session automation. Packaged as a standalone executable via PyInstaller and deployed using GitHub Actions CI/CD.
solutions: Implemented explicit processing states (PENDING, COMPLETED) to allow process resuming and checkpointing within Excel files.
Designed a batch processing algorithm grouping records into configurable chunks for submission, validation, confirmation, and state tracking.
Applied the Tenacity retry library to network requests and form submissions with fixed intervals and custom exception handling.
Engineered persistent HTTP session management using requests.Session with cookie handling and automated re-authentication.
Built an authentication pipeline handling login submissions, session validation, and post-login verification.
Parsed semi-structured HTML dynamically using BeautifulSoup and CSS selectors to extract form values, tokens, and validation errors.
Implemented mapping algorithms translating symbolic Excel selections into corresponding dynamic form values.
Constructed multi-tier validation checking user credentials, Excel schema compatibility, inputs, and server responses.
Created typed domain-specific exception classes to classify errors and handle distinct recovery pathways.
Used multithreading to keep execution logic separate from the CustomTkinter UI loop, using thread locks for shared file updates.
Implemented thread-safe file locking using threading.Lock around reading and writing operations on shared Excel files.
Built runtime Play, Pause, and Stop execution controls with safe process termination using custom exception signals.
Integrated Python's logging system with custom GUI text handlers to display real-time application logs.
Implemented single-instance execution guards using Portalocker file locks.
Configured CI/CD automation via GitHub Actions to build standalone Windows binaries using PyInstaller.

projects.title: Zifiti Web Scraping & Data Automation Platform
projects.description: Developed a Python/Scrapy-based web data extraction and automation platform for collecting structured product information from category-based e-commerce pages. Includes automated orchestration, cloud storage integration via Google Drive API, and customizable crawling policies.
solutions: Built an asynchronous crawling framework using Scrapy, separating category discovery from product detail parsing via spider callbacks.
Implemented recursive pagination algorithms to traverse category pages dynamically without hardcoded limits.
Designed a two-stage crawling architecture parsing listing indexes before extracting detailed item attributes.
Extracted structured catalog fields using CSS selectors, XPath expressions, and regular expressions.
Normalized extracted HTML data using BeautifulSoup to produce clean plaintext strings for ETL output.
Developed regex routines to parse complex string values into numerical height, width, depth, and unit attributes.
Implemented dynamic field mapping to convert dynamic platform tags into standardized data schemas.
Configured custom Scrapy downloader middleware to manage HTTP retries, request scheduling, and error handling.
Built a CLI wrapper using argparse to enable runtime configuration of category URLs and output options.
Constructed batch orchestration scripts to iterate through target URLs with execution delays.
Integrated Google Drive API using service account credentials to handle automatic remote uploads of generated CSV output files.
Implemented in-memory byte buffer management (BytesIO) for handling cloud file transfers directly.

projects.title: Social Search – AI-Powered Data Mining and Retrieval-Augmented Generation Platform
projects.description: Developed an AI-powered data mining and semantic search platform combining Django REST APIs, Scrapy-based data collection, vector embeddings, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). Built using Git submodules to separate main application logic from the crawling engine.
solutions: Structured project setup using Git submodules to encapsulate Scrapy crawling logic within the primary Django repository.
Developed Scrapy spiders to gather website metadata, company profiles, and tech stack information via external integrations.
Engineered multi-stage data enrichment pipelines chaining organization discovery, search queries, LLM profiling, and review aggregation.
Integrated LLMs directly into Scrapy processing loops to classify entity profiles during crawl execution.
Built an ETL pipeline using Django ORM to ingest raw JSON crawl artifacts into indexed PostgreSQL tables.
Constructed a RAG processing pipeline using LangChain to chunk document texts, generate OpenAI embeddings, and index vector representations within Pinecone.
Implemented vector similarity search routines querying Pinecone indexes to inject relevant context into LLM prompt chains.
Developed REST APIs using Django REST Framework and JWT authentication to support authenticated semantic chat applications.
Built a FastAPI prototype leveraging Pydantic models for validated JSON responses and vector-assisted product queries.
Configured custom Scrapy downloader middleware to enforce domain-specific request delays, proxy configurations, and caching.
Containerized web application components, vector management tasks, and PostgreSQL using Docker Compose and Nginx.

projects.title: UTM Tracking URL – URL Shortening and Campaign Analytics Platform
projects.description: Developed a Django-based URL shortening and UTM tracking platform that generates short URLs for campaign landing pages and records visitor metrics. Supported parameter management, click tracking, metadata collection, and containerized deployment via Docker Compose.
solutions: Designed Django ORM models to capture UTM campaign dimensions (source, medium, campaign, term, content, target URL) with optimized database indexing.
Built DRF endpoints for parameter validation and short link generation, using get_or_create() routines to minimize redundant database rows.
Implemented unique token generation using UUID encoding via ShortUUID.
Engineered HTTP redirect handlers capturing visitor metrics (IP address, user-agent, HTTP referrer) prior to target routing.
Used atomic database updates via Django F() expressions to handle accurate click count increments under concurrent traffic.
Configured OpenAPI/Swagger documentation using drf-yasg for client integration visibility.
Containerized the deployment using Docker Compose, PostgreSQL, Gunicorn, and Nginx with custom entrypoint setup scripts.

projects.title: Lazada Codingate API – E-commerce Product Scraping and Data Delivery Platform
projects.description: Developed a Django-based e-commerce data extraction and API platform that collects product information through asynchronous browser automation and exposes structured endpoints. Integrated Playwright, Celery, Redis, and PostgreSQL in a containerized microservices ecosystem.
solutions: Developed headless browser extraction scripts using Playwright and Chromium to intercept network responses and extract dynamic API payloads.
Implemented custom location-handling routines in Playwright, executing browser JS updates to refresh delivery postal codes prior to data extraction.
Built asynchronous product recommendation scraping logic capable of traversing nested dynamic content structures.
Designed PostgreSQL schemas utilizing JSONField structures to persist detailed product configurations alongside SHA-256 URL hashes for deduplication.
Architected asynchronous job dispatching using Celery queues backed by Redis to decouple API handling from browser worker execution.
Implemented browser slot directory management to control maximum concurrent browser processes and prevent resource exhaustion.
Built DRF REST endpoints offering structured product search, cache retrieval, client quota validation, and custom throttling logic.
Implemented two-tier retrieval mechanics checking local Redis cache keys before executing background web automation jobs.
Integrated Flower task management and Celery Beat schedule managers into containerized orchestration workflows.
Containerized infrastructure services using Docker Compose, Gunicorn, Nginx HTTPS reverse proxying, and automated Makefile scripts.

projects.title: Shopee Scraper – Scalable Browser Automation and Data Extraction Platform
projects.description: Developed a distributed e-commerce data extraction platform using a two-service architecture separating client API management from browser execution. Leveraged Selenium Grid and Docker clusters to scale automated browser instances across multi-region marketplace targets.
solutions: Architected a microservices layout splitting client interaction logic (Django/DRF) from browser execution environments.
Initial implementation of browser drivers in Node.js/Puppeteer, followed by migration to Python/Selenium Grid clusters for anti-bot mitigation and scaling.
Configured a distributed Selenium Hub and Node cluster inside Docker Compose, handling browser session lifecycle limits and resource sharing.
Constructed network response listeners within browser instances to extract structured JSON responses directly from internal API endpoints.
Engineered custom proxy integration extensions for browser instances to route regional requests across specified dynamic proxy ports.
Implemented asynchronous webhook delivery workers to notify client endpoints upon job completion.
Configured automated compression and storage policies for target payload responses within PostgreSQL.
Set up scheduled maintenance workflows via Django Cron to parse queued webhook jobs and audit system metrics.
Deployed deployment configurations across Linux servers managed via systemd unit files, Gunicorn application servers, and Git workflows.
